channel.title: WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News (wbbjtv.com)

item.title: Tennessee Department of Health confirms 3 weather-related fatalities
item.description: The Tennessee Department of Health has confirmed three weather-related fatalities.

item.title: Community members come together amid freezing temperatures
item.description: Many people are left without a warm place to stay during all of this winter weather so community members are doing what they can to take care of each other.

item.title: Fire destroys home in McNairy County, no injuries reported
item.description: A fire has destroyed one home in McNairy County.

item.title: State opens TBI hotline to assist with welfare check requests during Winter Storm Fern
item.description: In response to Winter Storm Fern and its ongoing impacts to road conditions and communications across the state, Tennessee has opened a dedicated hotline to assist with welfare check requests and reduce strain on local public safety agencies.

item.title: Proactive steps you can take to stay safe in winter weather
item.description: Freezing temperatures continue throughout portions of West Tennessee, the weekend winter storm has cleared out, but frigid temperatures continue throughout the area.

item.title: Officials provide look at next few days during freezing temperatures
item.description: We have a look at what you can expect with road conditions to shape up the rest of the week.

item.title: Tennessee Highway Patrol continues to assist motorists during winter storm
item.description: As ice, downed trees, and hazardous road conditions continue to impact travel across Tennessee, the Tennessee Highway Patrol (THP) has been working tirelessly to assist motorists.

item.title: Haywood Co. Fire Dept. responds to structure fire on Carlyle Williams Road
item.description: On the morning of January 26, 2026, the Haywood County Fire Department responded to a reported structure fire at 1248 Carlyle Williams Road, Bells, TN 38006 in Haywood County.

item.title: JPD shares proper way to report stalled, wrecked vehicles
item.description: The Jackson Police Department released a statement Monday detailing the system it is using to track which stalled or wrecked vehicles have been checked amid extreme weather conditions.

item.title: Hub City residents prepare for lasting extreme temperatures
item.description: Hub City residents are bracing for what could potentially be the coldest days of the year.
